description: Header file defining the interface and structures for logging backends in Zephyr OS, including backend API, control blocks, and management functions.

methods.name: log_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes a log backend, calling its init API if available.

methods.name: log_backend_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if a log backend is ready for processing.

methods.name: log_backend_msg_process
methods.description: Processes a log message through the backend.

methods.name: log_backend_dropped
methods.description: Notifies the backend about dropped log messages.

methods.name: log_backend_panic
methods.description: Reconfigures the backend to panic mode.

methods.name: log_backend_id_set
methods.description: Sets the ID for a backend.

methods.name: log_backend_id_get
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a backend.

methods.name: log_backend_get
methods.description: Retrieves a backend instance by index.

methods.name: log_backend_count_get
methods.description: Returns the total number of backends.

methods.name: log_backend_activate
methods.description: Activates a backend with a user context.

methods.name: log_backend_is_active
methods.description: Checks if a backend is active.

methods.name: log_backend_format_set
methods.description: Sets the log format for a backend.

methods.name: log_backend_notify
methods.description: Notifies a backend of an event.
